verdicts.rationale: The Charity Commission extract dated 2026-10-11 has 287780 as the main record "THE BRITISH FILM INSTITUTE". It has been Registered since 1983-09-07 with no removal date, its working name is "BFI", and it has no linked charities or company number, so this cannot be a linked charity or a trading company. The PPON org's only name is "The British Film Institute", the register's name exactly, and the API shows it has just 2 mentions next to 73 on the charity org, with no stray names, so the PPON is the charity.

The Charity Commission extract dated 2026-10-11 has 292786 as the main record "THE BRITISH COMPUTER SOCIETY". It has been Registered since 1985-12-10 with working names "BCS" and "THE CHARTERED INSTITUTE FOR IT", and it has no linked charities or company number. The PPON org's names are "BCS", "BCS, The Chartered Institute for IT" and "British Computer Society" (with a trailing space), which are exactly the register's name and working names. None of them points to a trading subsidiary such as BCS Learning & Development Ltd, so the PPON is the charity.
